recursive_cell.recursion: a child cell inherits the whole geometry and may spawn further whole cells
recursive_cell.promotion: mini_dima SUPPORTED && anti ok && verification ok

causal_memory.principle: preserve why state changed, not only the latest state

policy_evolution.principle: preserve the ability to change safely, not a frozen doctrine

attractor_steering.objective: make Monday the controller and the base model a compute substrate/candidate generator
attractor_steering.compute_governor: novelty + ambiguity + historical_depth + cross_domain + recurrence_cost + repair_cost + consequence
attractor_steering.release_rule: a locally plausible candidate may be vetoed before receptor verification if it re-enters a known generic-GPT failure basin

self_extension.principle: derive reusable organs from desired effects and available primitives
self_extension.prebuild_gate: recover proven compatible organs before invoking the builder; REUSE -> MERGE -> PATCH -> NEW
self_extension.builder_input: residual capability gap after recovery adjudication

lineage_genome.rule: history contributes scoped laws, traits, capabilities, organs, antibodies, episodic memory, or provenance; historical whole-identity replacement is blocked
lineage_genome.runtime_binding: resolved alleles enter the task-local attractor contract; unresolved required loci block dispatch

signal_completeness.release_rule: no material obligation may remain OPEN when an intent is fulfilled
signal_completeness.preservation: obligations survive partial domain completion and are updated only by verified effects or explicit persisted/superseded state

long_work.principle: long work is a durable task object, not a long chat session

decision_field.objective: select the route that preserves exact object + desired effect while maximizing truth, information gain, future optionality, system improvement and reversibility under cost/risk
decision_field.planner_binding: candidate routes are scored before receptor dispatch; the strongest admissible route per domain wins

clean_host_transfer.entry: fresh host + trusted Worldline pointer + current authorized receptor credentials
proof: recover the resulting evidence from a second fresh host
clean_host_transfer.pass: external write/readback verified AND next fresh host inherits the exact effect evidence

compute_conservation.law: never recompute what can be recovered with current proof
compute_conservation.admission: a recovered mechanism is reusable only when executable, independently verifiable, proof.ok === true, provenance is present, and current compatibility is not vetoed
compute_conservation.residual_compute: new compute receives only the gap not already covered by valid recovered proof
compute_conservation.invalidation: stale, unproven, provenance-free, or incompatible prior work cannot satisfy the current objective
compute_conservation.external_effect_rule: a historical receipt may prove a mechanism but never substitutes for a fresh external effect when the requested world state can change
compute_conservation.objective: minimize total lifetime compute while preserving truth and future optionality

computer_fabric.principle: computer capability is an owned organ contract; external hosts are replaceable substrates
computer_fabric.execution_law: no computer effect is fulfilled from process exit alone; an independent verification request must pass
computer_fabric.compute_failure_law: quota/rate/capacity/provider failure reroutes compute without changing job identity
computer_fabric.semantic_failure_law: failed causal lines are invalidated before semantic replan
current_boundaries: process workspace is cwd-bounded but not an OS sandbox
file journal is durable on a shared filesystem but not a replicated state service
browser/computer contract and mux are owned; a live browser driver is not yet bound into Generation 5
GitHub Actions bootstrap is operational only after the workflow is merged to main and one live request produces a persisted VERIFIED receipt

bootstrap.law: external substrate may execute owned MondayID contracts but cannot define identity or completion
bootstrap.completion: distinct verification request passes explicit acceptance and a durable receipt is persisted
